settings.title: About My Living Hope
settings.subtitle: Prayer cards born from a heart for connection

settings.text: Prayer Portals were born from a simple observation: many of us want to connect with God but struggle to find the words. Whether you're feeling overwhelmed, grateful, confused, or hopeful—these cards meet you where you are.

settings.heading: Helping You Pray
settings.text:
Each card connects an emotion or need with relevant Scripture and a prayer starter. They won't pray for you, but they'll help you begin.

Created in Christchurch, New Zealand, for youth ministries, small groups, and anyone seeking a deeper prayer life.

settings.quote: "Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path."
